name: @supermetry/node
description: Server-side Node.js SDK for Supermetry self-hosted web analytics

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --format esm --target node --packages external && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.cjs --format cjs --target node --packages external && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
